name: Mirabel Granbard
original_name: ミラベル＝グランバート
source:
The leader of a volunteer army formed by those who are concerned about the wars on the continent.

A worshipper of Manardi, the god of justice, protection and fertility, she liberated a city occupied by the Empire with only a small force, and since then, volunteer soldiers have gathered in one fell swoop, and she has quickly become known as the Saint of Manardi, the Valkyrie of the West, the Hero of the Nation, and the Hero of Light.

Many people say that she is a descendant of the Fileille Holy Warriors, the ancestors of the people of the Holy Kingdom who once saved the world from Ashley.

In battle, she leads the front lines carrying a battle flag with the Manardi crest on her back, and runs around the battlefield swinging her sword while encouraging her comrades.

Her noble appearance is said to even charm her enemies.
She remains pure in order to dedicate herself to God, and continues to save people with her pure soul, and sometimes shows mercy even to enemies.

However, her faith is too strong, and she shows no mercy to anyone who would tarnish the name of Manardi.

"I come from a simple farming family, and one day I heard the voice of God, and I acted with the desire to save people," she says.

Although she is a little confused by the fact that she is praised more than necessary, she accepts it as a necessary part of leading the volunteer soldiers as their leader.
